title: Conditional κ = 0.00364665195644: fuse helper 319’s paid lifts
head: aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Fuse helper 319's rank-five and rank-one lifts into one rank-six lift. The
complete signed 17-stage caller supports **conditional κ = 0.00364665195644**,
up **0.000000430519994** over exact #7314.

The 18-event chart-207 block has two exact rational identities. One routes
the removed direction to two peers already lifted to chart 127. The other
recovers helper 319's dirty return from those corrected values. The emitted
word changes the paid profile by `P1 −17, P5 −17, P6 +17` across all 17
copies. The complete bill has 110,519 paid and 22,461 productive positions,
surplus 1,424 and no empty-root credit. The fixed-profile packing relaxation
is about 0.005810141579, with 62.76% realized.

## Task and overlap

Changed scope of `p104-side-correction`, revision 8, on current main
`e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The parent is #7314 at
`9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91`, with the exact signed #7113
caller at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. Only field 319's
transport path changes. The constructor authenticates and regenerates
the exact parent from its retained source archive.

#7312 fixes a single intervening contact, #7171 fixes read timing, and
#7329 keeps the original scalar charts. This witness moves a coframed
component to its common legal clock and repairs both sides of the cut.
#6529 is an earlier compensated fusion on a different word. [Coordination
and local witness](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19552466).
The two exact #7257 commits are included as hosted replay prerequisites.

## Validation

    python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-helper-319-fused-return --check-modes --check-source-history

Local direct verification matched all 1,501 arbitrary-input output rows
and the literal COPY guard. The full native replay checks the chart maps
and phases, ownership, grid, precision, ordinary work and rejecting controls.
The complete signed replay checks 3,037 physical maps, 104 main
boundaries, the literal caller and all 54 strict and four functional outer
predicates. The signed ordinary bound is 782,715,464, and the precision

See [the package receipts](research/p104-helper-319-fused-return/README.md).

chart-207 identities and the 1089→127 phase on this exact head, then replay

with independent human or formal review and maintainer selection open.

title: Verify stage-8 Type A QUERY retiming and bound direct helper carriers
head: 1ec899dade2febbfb155f0ca015b9cc0356bd7e2
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Hoist the 14 paid Type A idle calls at clocks 1448–1487 before stage-8 J at port 0. Cancelling 28 ordinary ADDs makes the retiming exact. The required stage-8 correction for demoting QUERYs 1580 and 1659 now depends only on body B8 and the central phase. It requires two independent input aggregates and one shared scatter outside the four bound roles.

The four productive helper MOVEs with the pure central rank-one quotient each fail the chart-0 first-contact readout. With the native suffix fixed, the helper-return minor has determinant `-5/8`.

The timed follow-up grants all 447 observations across seven charts and all eight matching MOVE injections. It finds one additional mode if the original four port inputs are supplied. Two protected terminal returns at charts 140 and 150 force that mode to zero under chart-local restoration. A coframed entrance compensation of carrier 225 restores all original helpers and unrelated main outputs. Its entire surviving effect equals an ordinary ADD into native input 112, the port-0 Y lane. The required opposite-sign phase difference has rank at least four and that ordinary addition supplies no extra signed response. All four retained chart-128 to chart-127 exits after the late readout have exact full-state input separators before their next contacts, so an immediate loan cannot expose that response either. The paired QUERY deletion remains open and the verified κ change is zero.

## Task and overlap

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Changed scope of `p104-side-correction` on exact #7113 `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d` and #7334 `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`. Two follow-up commits add the timed readout, restoration and late exit tests. Both build on the existing #7257 CI prerequisites.

#7342–#7344 supply the standalone correction, relative rank floor and fixed-host capacity limits. #7393 checks a different owned write aggregate. #7401 keeps J fixed for diagonal phase retirement, #7403 tests absorbing native first lifts, and #7405 studies a fixed Type B port conversion. This package concerns the port-0 stage-8 paired QUERY demand and literal carrier readout and return.

## Validation

```sh

python3.12 -I -B research/p104-stage8-query-carrier/verify_temporal.py

The follow-up verifies all 466 snapshots in forward and reverse directions for the carrier columns, two terminal input imitations, the entrance compensation and its omitted-term control, the exact phase minor, and all four late exit witnesses. It checks a normalized boundary identity and scoped obstructions. New phase-provider lowering, owned storage, adjoint and full supplier costs remain open.

Rohan Arun's #7113 supplies the signed caller and Clear1nsight's #7334 the native comparator. ToikY's #7342–#7344 supply the formal engines and capacity checks and #7393 a related temporal method. Dillon's #5388 and #7244 supply the separate paid-hoisting and funded entry-basis precedents. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. ChatGPT Pro helped formulate the causal and dirty-return tests.

title: Fuse two encoded CRT payload sorts into one
head: cf62e701f52adf2196923ab7356539e69713d55b
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

One live encoded CRT root now routes all 16 marked records of the retained `two_short_first` right rectangle. Writing both destination fields before sorting gives the same forward frame as sorting after each axis. The fused route takes four literal radix passes and 492,724 radix instructions. The matched staged route takes eight passes and 985,448 radix instructions. Both forward arms execute the same numerical work, two ROM calls and 96 physical row queries. The fused inverse restores the original payload, source, physical backing and entry heads.

The independent CRT oracle checks the complete permutation from the fixed left state `(1,5)`, including padded coordinates, and source `(1,5,2,1)` → `(1,5,0,0)` → `(1,5,2,1)`. `RESULT.json` records the live headers, shared bank and separate execution counts. This is a finite matched comparison under the retained full-frame radix ABI. A complete multiplier, a common literal tariff and a numerical κ improvement remain open.

## Task and overlap

Refined `uniform-transfer-audit` scope (priority revision 8). #5519 at `53a034436f17ef5b8fdf7a02f5066528cdfe5446` supplies the retained fixture and shared-bank record-alignment invariant. #7352 at `8c0e55c9ba25ff2c8199b01539a4d56ae71a1473` supplies the live forward/inverse root, with #7351's shared writer. #7388 executes one right-axis fiber. This change uses its unchanged row traversal and literal mover for both axes of one root and adds the matched comparison. [Discussion #4709 claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19559193).

The branch starts from canonical `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and carries the exact #7388 dependency commit `d6f4a69202ad0bba4a915f4d4f3eaba1fe431c86` plus its two unchanged #7257 onboarding prerequisites. Review the seven new package files in [the follow-up commit](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/commit/cf62e701f52adf2196923ab7356539e69713d55b).

## Validation

Run `python3.12 -I -B research/encoded-crt-two-target-payload/replay.py`. The registered replay and Python optimized replay passed in about 17 seconds each locally. The committed source history, bytes and modes passed preflight, and the checked Git-free export replay passed. Dropping the fast target moves tag `293` to slot 4 instead of 5. An unequal-width header-only case detects reusing the first offset on the second target. The noncommuting inverse-row and truncated-row controls also run.

## Credit

Commdata2338 (#5519), CubeJerry (#7351, #7352), Ali Romman (#5625) and JoyboyBrian (#5092, #5496, #5015). OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro materially assisted. Pro derived the slot map and checked the isolated radix component with supplied keys. Apache-2.0.
